subject: Re: Sunday setup
text:
Hi,

I meant to message earlier, then the hall schedule jumped again and I lost my train. Sorry. Remember the volunteer table we planned near the coat rack? It will not fit. A late donation cart is there. The staff said not to block the exit. I measured twice, badly. The table might need to shift behind the pillar. That is okay, maybe better? But then the sign-up sheet cannot be seen from the door. I am worried people will walk past us. Also the card reader keeps asking for the network name, which I do not know, and someone moved the router anyway.

Can you tell me if we should leave the extra chairs in the closet? I have half a stack outside. A woman asked if we take bags. I said yes? I might be wrong. Also, my lanyard is missing, so I am writing this with shaky fingers because I forgot the pen too. I checked the volunteer folder. It says bring scissors, but I have tape. Is tape enough? If we use tape, do we need to avoid the paper banners? Please say something simple. Maybe one short answer. The clock is being rude and the room still smells like coffee from breakfast. I am at the table now, pretending to look organized. The cart has a wobbly wheel. It may roll.

If the pillar is fine for the table, I can stack the flyers there. If not, I will ask the man by the door, but he looks busy and I do not want to bother him too much. I am sorry for sending this so late. Last-minute complication, yes.

Thanks,
Volunteer
